svg.aria-label: Crypto Research Desk. Research-only crypto market intelligence: five specialist functions build one forecast packet and an independent risk gate reviews it. The browser workbench inspects, edits, reviews and exports packets, and starts on a synthetic DEMO packet. Shown as five pillars feeding one packet that rises through a gate ring.
